resources.name: Skills For Designers and Engineers
resources.summary: A collection of Agent Skills for designers and engineers focused on better UI, animation, design decisions, Swift, and interface tooling.
use_cases: Guide coding agents toward stronger UI and motion decisions
Review and improve animations
Prototype UI variants
Help agents choose trusted UI libraries
resources.notes: Especially useful with AI coding agents when visual quality and motion taste matter.

resources.name: Refero Styles
resources.summary: A searchable library of 2,000+ AI-readable design-system references derived from real product websites, including DESIGN.md, typography, spacing, colors, components, and tokens.
use_cases: Give coding agents concrete visual references before building UI
Copy DESIGN.md-style context for AI-assisted frontend work
Study design tokens and component patterns
Find visual directions by brand or style
resources.notes: The Styles library was freely browsable when checked; Refero MCP and the main Refero product may have separate plans.

resources.name: SoundShockAudio
resources.summary: A curated library of free music-production resources including VST plugins, sample packs, synth presets, DAW templates, Kontakt instruments, MIDI files, and apps.
use_cases: Find free audio tools for games, video, music, and media production
Browse VST plugins and effects
Find sample packs and sound effects
Locate DAW templates, presets, and Kontakt instruments
resources.notes: Individual third-party downloads have their own licenses; verify each tool or sample pack before commercial reuse.

resources.name: Hallmark
resources.summary: An MIT-licensed design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex that builds, audits, redesigns, and studies interfaces while actively avoiding common AI-generated design patterns.
use_cases: Generate more distinctive frontend designs
Audit existing UI for generic AI-design patterns
Redesign a site while preserving content and information architecture
Extract design DNA from screenshots or URLs into reusable design context
resources.notes: Strong fit when an AI coding agent produces technically correct but visually generic pages.

resources.name: IP as Logo
resources.summary: A compact MIT-licensed Agent Skill for generating simple, cute, company-ready IP mascots with strict silhouette, color, composition, and complexity guidance.
use_cases: Create brand mascots and simple character IP
Generate consistent square mascot concepts with image-capable agents
Explore multiple controlled mascot directions for a product or company
resources.notes: Requires a compatible agent with a capable image-generation model for the intended workflow.

resources.name: React Bits — Shape Grid
resources.summary: A React Bits animated background resource for building a shape-grid visual effect in React interfaces.
use_cases: Add a distinctive animated background to landing pages
Prototype visual hero sections
Use as frontend interaction inspiration
resources.notes: React Bits currently offers both free resources and Pro content; verify the specific component license before redistribution.

resources.name: UI Skills
resources.summary: A large design-engineering skill registry for AI coding agents covering accessibility, motion, frameworks, testing, performance, craft, and visual quality.
use_cases: Route AI agents to task-specific UI guidance
Audit accessibility and motion performance
Improve frontend design quality
Browse reusable design-engineering skills
resources.notes: The site listed 221 skills when checked; the associated ibelick/ui-skills project is MIT-licensed.

resources.name: Cloudflare Dashboard
resources.summary: Cloudflare's control panel for Workers, Pages, R2, D1 and other edge, storage, networking, security, and developer services.
use_cases: Deploy web applications and Workers
Manage R2 object storage
Create and operate D1 databases
Manage domains and Cloudflare developer services
resources.notes: Stored as the generic dashboard URL; never store account tokens, API keys, or secret-bearing URLs in the public catalog.

resources.name: xorxor_hu on CodePen
resources.summary: A public CodePen creator profile saved as a frontend visual and code-reference source.
use_cases: Browse frontend experiments
Collect UI and animation inspiration
Study individual public Pens before adapting ideas
resources.notes: The profile page could not be reliably inspected during ingestion, so content quality and individual Pen licensing remain unverified.

resources.name: Oracle Cloud Free Tier
resources.summary: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure free tier with Always Free resources plus a time-limited free trial for eligible OCI services.
use_cases: Run small cloud VMs and proof-of-concept workloads
Use Always Free compute and storage within limits
Test OCI databases and infrastructure services
resources.notes: Oracle currently documents Always Free resources and a US$300/30-day trial; capacity, region and eligibility limits apply.

resources.name: Supabase Dashboard
resources.summary: Supabase's hosted developer platform and dashboard for Postgres databases, auto-generated APIs, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime and Storage.
use_cases: Build application backends quickly
Manage Postgres data and SQL
Add authentication and storage
Deploy Edge Functions and realtime features
resources.notes: The user-supplied organization-specific dashboard URL was intentionally replaced with the generic public dashboard URL before publishing to this public repository.

resources.name: Mistral Studio
resources.summary: Mistral AI's developer console for API keys, model playgrounds, agents, evaluations, usage monitoring, text, audio, OCR and RAG workflows.
use_cases: Create and manage Mistral API keys
Prototype prompts in a model playground
Build AI applications and agents
Use Mistral text, audio, OCR and RAG APIs
resources.notes: The supplied authentication-flow URL was not stored because login flow parameters are temporary. Mistral currently documents a Free mode with limits and no card required for initial API access.

resources.name: Capafy AI
resources.summary: A Skill-based AI Agent marketplace where users can discover and run specialist agents and creators can package and sell reusable Skills.
use_cases: Discover specialist Agent Skills
Run Skills in the browser
Use skills with supported agent clients such as Codex and Claude Code
Publish and monetize reusable AI Skills
resources.notes: Marketplace listings can use different pricing models; review each Skill's price and privacy details before use.
